## About
This image carries the **insider version** of the Windows ML container base OS image.

**Lifecycle Notices:**
- **The 19551.1001-based Windows ML container image published on January 24, 2020 is the final update to this image until further notice**

## Related Repositories
+ [windows/insider](https://mcr.microsoft.com/en-us/product/windows/insider/about): Insider version of the Windows base OS image
+ [windows/nanoserver/insider](https://mcr.microsoft.com/en-us/product/windows/nanoserver/insider/about): Insider version of the Windows Nano Server base OS image
+ [windows/servercore/insider](https://mcr.microsoft.com/en-us/product/windows/servercore/insider/about): Insider version of the Windows Server Core base OS image

## Configuration
- Your host must have the Windows container feature enabled and version matched to the Windows ML container.
- Windows ML container only support running with process isolation, and does not support Hyper-V isolation. 

## Usage
Windows requires the host OS version to match the container OS version. If you want to run a container based on a newer Windows build, make sure you have an equivalent host build.  Please refer to the [Windows ML container Getting Started guide](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/ai/windows-ml-container/).

The default entrypoint is for this image is Cmd.exe. To run the image:

docker run `mcr.microsoft.com/windows/ml/insider:10.0.{build}.{revision}`

**Note: This repo does not publish or maintain a** `latest` **tag. Please declare a specific tag when pulling or referencing images from this repo.**

## Support
For support or general questions, please post in our [forum](https://social.msdn.microsoft.com/Forums/en-US/home?forum=windowscontainers).

## Feedback
Please direct all feedback to our [forum](https://social.msdn.microsoft.com/Forums/en-US/home?forum=windowscontainers).

Suggestions on improving Windows Containers or issues can also be raised at the [repo](https://github.com/microsoft/Windows-Containers).
